title: Minimum Lot Width
previewText: In Special Coastal Risk District 2, the regulations of Section 23-11 (Lot Area and Lot Width in R1 Through R5 Districts) are modified such that the minimum lot width for a two-family detached residence in an R3A District shall be 40 feet.
